steps.prompt:
Here is a job posting. List the 6 must-have keywords a recruiter would search for: the hard skills, tools and qualifications that are required, repeated, or listed first. Use the posting's exact wording, and quote the line each one comes from. Then list up to 5 nice-to-have keywords on their own.

Job posting:
[PASTE THE JOB POSTING]
steps.out:
6 must-have keywords

Ranked by importance based on repetition, prominence, and explicit qualifications in the posting.

1. Integrated Campaigns

Quote: “Build and run integrated campaign plans for one or more products, owning to the annual plan, tiered campaign calendar, budget, and pipeline forecast”

2. Demand Generation

Quote: “8+ years operating marketing lead/demand generation campaigns: webinars, advertising campaigns, ABM, etc.”

3. Full-Funnel Campaigns

Quote: “strategize and execute full-funnel campaigns for a portfolio of key products.”

4. Marketing Automation (Salesforce, Hubspot, Marketo)

Quote: “Experience working with CRM and marketing automation (Salesforce, Hubspot, Marketo, etc.), ad platforms, and BI tools (PowerBI, Tableau, Metabase, etc.)”

5. Pipeline and Revenue Attribution

Quote: “Proven track record tying campaigns to pipeline and revenue, with experience owning a budget and making trade-offs across channels, vendors, and regions”

6. AI Workflows

Quote: “Proven use cases with AI workflows to improve marketing efficiency and outcomes”

Up to 5 nice-to-have keywords

These are relevant differentiators that strengthen an application:

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

Product-Led Growth (PLG)

Paid Social and Search

Webinars and Content Syndication

BI Tools (PowerBI, Tableau, Metabase)

Recruiter insight: The strongest ATS keyword strategy is to prioritize Integrated Campaigns, Demand Generation, Marketing Automation, Pipeline and Revenue Attribution, and AI Workflows. These capture the central responsibilities and the technical qualifications Datadog explicitly seeks.

steps.prompt:
Here is my resume. Rewrite my summary for this posting in 2 or 3 sentences. Use the must-have keywords only where my resume shows that experience, and keep my numbers exactly as they are. Don't add years, tools or skills my resume doesn't have. After the summary, list each must-have keyword you left out because my resume doesn't show it.

Resume:
[PASTE YOUR RESUME]
steps.out:
Rewritten summary
Writing

B2B demand generation marketing lead with seven years of experience planning and executing campaigns across email, social, and search, growing qualified leads 38% in one year. Experienced in campaign strategy, paid media, and budget management, overseeing a $1.2M paid media budget across four channels and reducing cost per lead 22%. Skilled in campaign performance reporting using Google Analytics, SEO, and A/B testing to improve marketing results.

Must-have keywords left out

These keywords were excluded because your resume does not demonstrate the required experience:

Integrated Campaigns – No explicit experience managing integrated, full-funnel campaigns.

Full-Funnel Campaigns – No evidence of full-funnel campaign ownership.

Marketing Automation (Salesforce, Hubspot, Marketo) – No CRM or marketing automation platforms listed.

Pipeline and Revenue Attribution – No explicit pipeline or revenue attribution experience.

AI Workflows – No AI workflow experience listed.

Note: Your resume supports Demand Generation, but does not currently substantiate the broader integrated campaign or marketing technology requirements.

steps.prompt: Now rewrite the bullets for my [JOB TITLE] role at [EMPLOYER]. Start each bullet with the strongest matching keyword from the posting, in the posting's words, where it's true. Keep every number and result exactly as it is. Don't change my job title, employer or dates, and don't merge, drop or add bullets. Show each one as Before and After.
steps.out:
